EC1: - Concomitant Aortic Stenosis which is associated with an acquired von Willebrand Syndrome (aVWS)
EC2: - Patients with a baseline platelet count of <100x109/L
EC3: - Patients with a known coagulation factor deficiency [OR] or platelet function disorder
EC4: - Patients receiving heparin therapy prior to CPB within last 7 days
